title: Zapier
description: Allow to send instant triggers to Zapier API.

settings_def.name: url
settings_def.label: Zapier URL
settings_def.description: This is the URL to your Zapier site (without any trailing slash).

settings_def.name: api_user
settings_def.label: Zapier API User
settings_def.description: Enter the name of an API user that you setup in Zapier via System > Web Services > SOAP/XML-RPC - Users.

settings_def.name: api_key
settings_def.label: Zapier API Key
settings_def.description: Enter the API key for your user.

settings_def.name: widget_ticket
settings_def.label: Enable Ticket Widget
settings_def.description: Show the Zapier widget on tickets

settings_def.name: widget_profile
settings_def.label: Enable Profile Widget
settings_def.description: Show the Zapier widget on user profiles

settings_def.name: enable_usersource
settings_def.label: Enable User Source
settings_def.description: Allow users to log in to DeskPRO using their Zapier credentials?

settings_def.name: enable_sso
settings_def.label: Enable Background SSO
settings_def.description: When SSO is enabled, users will be automatically logged-in if they visit DeskPRO while they have an active Zapier session.

settings_def.name: auto_agent
settings_def.label: Auto Agent
settings_def.checkbox_label: Automatically create agents if they do not already exist

settings_def.name: raw_info_filter
settings_def.label: Filter
settings_def.description: You can filter based on info provided by the usersource. Learn about this feature
